overview: Polio is a highly infectious disease caused by a virus. It invades the nervous system and can cause total paralysis in a matter of hours. The virus is transmitted by person-to-person spread mainly through the faecal-oral route or, less frequently, by a common vehicle (for example, contaminated water or food) and multiplies in the intestine.
symptoms: Total paralysis in a matter of hours
treatment: There is no cure for polio, it can only be prevented
complications: Death when breathing muscles become immobilized
key_facts: One in 200 infections leads to irreversible paralysis
5–10% of those paralysed die when their breathing muscles become immobilized
Cases due to wild poliovirus have decreased by over 99% since 1988
